description:
Pokémon Battle Revolution is the series' first game on the Wii. Battle through 10 different Colosseums
on your way to the rank of Pokétopia Master, all in the mainline games' famous turn-based battles!

- [Info Page](https://github.com/Axcel-Snowpix/PokemonRevoAP/blob/main/worlds/pokemon_revo/docs/en_Pok%C3%A9mon%20Battle%20Revolution.md)

## Changelog
- It's the initial release!
## Known Issues
The D-Pad controls are, for the most part, completely unusable when selecting a Colosseum to enter. Fixing this would take a complete rewrite of how this functions, so don't expect it for a bit.
For now, you can use the Wii Remote pointer instead.
v0.1.0.title: Pokémon Battle Revolution 0.1.0

v0.1.1.description:
- [Info Page](https://github.com/Axcel-Snowpix/PokemonRevoAP/blob/main/worlds/pokemon_revo/docs/en_Pok%C3%A9mon%20Battle%20Revolution.md)
- [Setup Guide](https://github.com/Axcel-Snowpix/PokemonRevoAP/blob/main/worlds/pokemon_revo/docs/setup_en.md)
## Changelog
- Fixed the D-Pad controls in the Colosseum Battle menu.
- Fixed an issue where the client wouldn't connect unless the Player already had at least 1 save file.
- Fixed an issue where the client would sometimes fail to get the multiworld seed.
- Fixed an issue where multiworlds generated with the same seed could have different starting Colosseums.
- disc-riider-py is no longer required to load the APWorld and generate multiworlds (it is still required to patch the game though).
- Raised the minimum AP version to 0.6.8
v0.1.1.title: Pokémon Battle Revolution 0.1.1

v0.2.0.description:
- [Info Page](https://github.com/Axcel-Snowpix/PokemonRevoAP/blob/main/worlds/pokemon_revo/docs/en_Pokémon%20Battle%20Revolution.md)
- [Setup Guide](https://github.com/Axcel-Snowpix/PokemonRevoAP/blob/main/worlds/pokemon_revo/docs/setup_en.md)
## Changelog
- Added Battlesanity: Get checks for winning each individual battle in a given Colosseum.
- Added locations to Stargazer Colosseum, with an option to remove them.
- Added new filler items:
  - 500 Poké Coupons & 1000 Poké Coupons
  - Healing items
  - Stat boosts
  - +1 Perfect Point
- Added traps:
  - Non-Volatile Status Conditions
  - Stat drops
  - Metronome Trap
- Added options to customize filler item and trap weights.
- Added Death Link, with two different modes:
  - Battle Loss: Deaths will be sent when you lose a battle, and receiving deaths will cause you to instantly lose the current battle.
  - Pokémon Faint: Deaths will be sent when one of your Pokémon faint, and receiving deaths will cause one of the Pokémon you have currently sent out to faint.
  - Includes support for Death Link groups.
  - All Death Link related options can be changed mid-game using Client commands.
- Added Damage Link.
  - Includes support for Damage Link groups.
  - All Damage Link related options can be changed mid-game using Client commands.
- Increased maximum number of Pokétopia Badges to 50.
- Client now displays current version number upon opening it.
- Beating Stargazer Colosseum no longer puts you in the post-game, as to prevent softlocks in multiworlds with release disabled.
- When tracking if Stargazer Colosseum should be unlocked, your Colosseum clears are now saved to the server, rather than being kept locally.  
  
This version is NOT backwards compatible with multiworlds generated in previous versions.
v0.2.0.title: Pokémon Battle Revolution 0.2.0
